title: Machine Learning-Driven Prediction and Optimization of Thermoelectric Transport Properties in Ce-Doped CaMnO3 Ceramics.
summary: The study reports measured Ce-doped CaMnO3 transport data modeled with SVM, MLP, XGBoost and CNN-LSTM; the CNN-LSTM interpretation locates a candidate region at x=0.05–0.06 and 350–500 °C, with a simulated power factor above 0.35 mW/K²m. The finding is a model-guided interpretation of the measured material series; the predicted optimum itself was not synthesized or independently validated.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s materials dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
